classes.name: Warrior
classes.intent: The melee anchor. Armour is a mobility stat here — the Warrior is who finishes a run through threatened ground.
classes.bonusMoveNote: 2 stamina, 2 hexes, +2 Strength until end of Turn.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.intent: Standoff damage. Reach and Vision are its real stats and both are near-invisible, which is the design's own warning label.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.intent: Stealth, poison and bleed, daggers and thrown weapons. Arrives, strikes, and is gone before the answer lands.

classes.name: Mage
classes.intent: Magic damage and the terrain layer. Staves scale their basic attacks off Precision; only the big powers spend Magic.
classes.bonusMoveNote: 0 stamina, moves you ZERO hexes, gain 1 Stamina. A caught caster stays caught.

classes.name: Priest
classes.intent: True damage — it skips Armor and Resist both. Hits soft, hits reliably, and is the only thing standing between a fallen hero and the clock.
classes.bonusMoveNote: 0 stamina, moves you ZERO hexes, -1 Stamina Max for the Battle, gain 2 Stamina.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.intent: Armour, auras and protection, with slayer bonuses against undead and demon. The wall that also punishes.

classes.name: Civilian
classes.intent: An ordinary class, surfaced at different times. One action, no stamina bar, low-decision — three of them fill the flex slot one hero would.
classes.bonusMoveNote: No bonus move. The Civilian carries; it does not scramble.

classes.name: Beast
classes.intent: Teeth, hide and mass. The Beast is the mirror of the Civilian: it is granted NO Item Slots at any level, so nothing it does comes out of a bag — every point of it is the animal.

stats.name: Accuracy
stats.does: the core roll. surplus over 100 becomes Crit at ÷4
stats.note: loses value as you stack it

stats.name: Luck
stats.does: flat subtraction from the ATTACKER's crit chance

stats.name: Reach
stats.does: ranged weapons only. melee gains nothing

stats.name: Dodge
stats.does: flat to-hit penalty on the attacker
stats.note: GAINS value as you stack it — +100 Dodge would break the game

stats.name: Vision
stats.does: a radius, base 6. bites in darkness, fog and stealth-detection

stats.name: Resist
stats.does: flat mitigation, magic — and burn/poison per tick, never bleed

stats.name: Toughness
stats.does: injury capacity, and the base for Deathbed Fighting
stats.note: injury capacity, and the base for Deathbed Fighting

stats.name: Movement
stats.does: hexes per move action. heroes 5, enemies 4

stats.name: Stamina Max
stats.does: the throttle. a level-1 hero has 5

stats.name: Stamina Regen
stats.note: THE SACRED STAT. as expensive as Armor, and it hard-caps at 3

stats.name: Surge
stats.does: base value equals the character's level
stats.note: fine to modify — it is not a sacred stat

art.note: 19 assets per hero template, not per hero — which is why a generated hero costs no new art. 30 generative templates → 30 art sets.

sets.set: Hex map art — the battle-map token
Unconscious art — does NOT vary by level

art.rule: A status OVERRIDES the level band totally. A level-7 vampire shows vampire art, not tier-3 art. No merge.
